items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: Do you remember when Emil worked in his band? ... Sometime I would work with him on the, with the Alphurs Sax.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Do you say you worked with Chris Kelly's band? I was not a regular member of his band, but I worked with his band. Do you remember when Emil worked in his band?
Yeah. He was with him a long time, huh?
